description: Confirmed 2026 npm supply-chain incidents. Package names alone are not treated as malicious. Critical version matches require an exact package and version; targeted node_modules scanning only reads the named package families and still requires a published IOC match to report malicious code.

rulesets.name: Recent npm supply-chain IOC rules
rulesets.sourceNote: Based on public technical incident reports from Socket Research for the Keyv/Cacheable, AsyncAPI, Joyfill, and Alibaba-targeted campaigns, plus the publicly reported Red Hat Miasma version subset. Entries are deliberately limited to confirmed versions and high-specificity payload markers.
